|game_text=If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 different Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test (cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground). Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 5). The image is the slip of the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet ([[:File:VB6-89-Strong_Is_Vader-original-sheet.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, first copy of the release sheet, 4 September 2009); [[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]] (PC-E1, revised release sheet); [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as PC-E1); [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 different Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test (cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground). Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “89” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]]): the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (PDF dated 20 April 2010) removed “different” and “(cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground)”: “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (still headed "Official text as of September 4, 2009"; PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 12, slip 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image prints this text too. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 31) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E4 ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata 4)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=31, page 31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=31 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee news of 21 September 2009 announced an errata to Strong Is Vader, “taking effect immediatly”, and an updated Reflections IV PDF, but does not quote the text<ref name="pcnews-72">Players Committee news “Strong Is Vader / Rebel Fleet changes”, 21 September 2009 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222713/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=72 Internet Archive copy])</ref>. This is the only Strong Is Vader errata known between the first sheet and the revised sheet, so this text most likely dates from 21 September 2009.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012), in an entry labelled “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, changed “You Have Learned” to “You have Learned” and “choose one” to “chose one” (typos as published): “If [Virtual] Mind What You have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and chose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="cl-1261_87-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-strongisvader-pre.gif]]) prints the PC-E1 text of the revised release sheet ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]]) again, word for word: “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “89” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 31)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the PC-E1 text of the revised release sheet ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]]) again, word for word: “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-87-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “89”).
